"This elevator is broken!  I will enter the shaft and try to fix it.  I know it goes up to the surface, and would be a better
route than trying to cross the malfunctioning bridge again!"
"I will have this elevator working in a moment!  Wait a second, then take it up!"
"This elevator is broken!  I will enter the shaft and try to fix it.  I know it goes up to the surface, and would be a better
route than trying to cross the malfunctioning bridge again!"
"Go, find Kaito!  When you find him, I will have this elevator working and you should take it up!"
"Not yet!  We still must find Kaito!  Or at least his body!"
You take the elevator back to the surface.
You startle a terrified boy, who nearly jumps out of his skin when you greet him.
He looks back and forth between members of your party, breathing heavily.
"Whoah, easy there big guy...  Hey you're Kaito, aren't you?  Your mom sent us to get you back home.  We're here to help you, and
make sure no one else tries to hurt you."
"We also came with one of the ninjas of the town.  Do you know Kenji?"
Kaito runs to Kenji's arms and hugs him, a look of relief coming over his face.
"Kaito, we are here to get you home.  Trust these people!  We need to get going!"
"Yeah come on, kiddo, your mom wants you back home right away.  She's really worried about you."
Niko speaks up:  "That bridge isn't safe, and it's gears aren't reliable either, as we've already seen.  I know where the elevator we
passed goes, it goes up to the surface.  I know it's a little broken, but I can run back and get it working in just a few minutes."
"Do whatever you want to do before you leave the sewers, and when you're ready to leave, with Kaito, go back to the elevator and take it
up to the exit.  I'll be waiting for all of you at that exit.  Okay?"
"Okay, sounds good.  Kaito, stick with us, we'll get you back home safely."
(Note that Kaito is half starving, so his nutrition points are low.)
"We should stick together and get moving.  Niko should have that elevator working by now."
